column7:
Augmentation in
provision of ₹45.00 lakh
was the net effect of
increase of ₹47.50 lakh
and decrease by re-
appropriation of
₹2.50 lakh. Increase was
attributed to need of
additional amounts in
contract services, other
allowance, maintenance
and fuel of van, office
expenses and medical
reimbursement. Decrease
was attributed to
anticipated saving.
Reasons for final saving
have not been intimated
(July 2024).
